mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1300K units, indicating strengthened consumer demand, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1300K, or the correlation between HOUST and SPX returns over the next 5d is not significantly positive (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs decrease.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during periods of FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly higher than those during periods of FEDFUNDS >= 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.5% and remains there for 2 consecutive months, indicating a tight labor market, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days are positively affected as a strong labor market boosts consumer spending.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or the mechanism fails to predict > 55% of positive 60d returns when triggered.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a decrease in the GDP price index (GDPC1) suggests improved supply-side efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as productivity gains are capitalized by investors.
failure_condition: The joint behavior of INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to predict > 50% of positive 20d SPX returns over any 2-year period, or the mechanism's Rank IC falls below 0.01 in walk-forward analysis.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: Positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days are driven by the consistent growth in real disposable personal income (RSAFS), as consumers continually drive economic activity.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are not significantly positively correlated with RSAFS growth over any 3-year window (p > 0.1), or the mechanism's walk-forward IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 1.5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is below 250, indicating a controlled inflation environment, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are negatively affected as higher borrowing costs dampen economic growth without triggering inflation fears.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails to predict > 50% of negative 20d returns when triggered over any 2-year period, or its walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: In a regime of falling unemployment (UNRATE) below 5%, an additional drop in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% in one month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as a rapidly improving labor market boosts economic growth.
failure_condition: The mechanism's predictive power for positive 60d returns when UNRATE is below 5% and drops significantly is not confirmed in > 55% of triggered instances over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on interaction: The combined effect of increasing industrial production (INDPRO) and decreasing GDP (GDPC1) always positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as improved supply-side dynamics are consistently capitalized by investors.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows the mechanism's Rank IC for predicting positive 20d returns remains below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window, or the joint behavior of INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to significantly positively correlate with SPX returns (p > 0.1).
